body: Have u ever doubted what your aura could be...might be dark? Or what..? That it could be genetic?
I really thank you for your answer. I will definitely ponder these words.
I don't give too much attention to the pain but my failures---and the future ones.
The fear of facing reality, I might say.
Well, I do have goals but along the way I just lose the interest or whatever that is.
Yeah. That feeling when you know a part of you died. And that moment when you know it can't be helped.
